info.title: Zogograph Key Custody API
info.description: Optional remote custody for wrapped per-artifact data-key envelopes. An enrolled client receives only an X25519 public wrapping key, seals its fresh data key locally, and may later request that named artifact data key through separately authenticated unwrap authorization.

get.summary: Read service liveness without tenant or credential data

200.description: Private SQLite service store opened successfully

post.summary: Create a tenant custody key record

patch.summary: Update policy, disable, rotate, or retire a key

get.summary: Read the active public key for client-side artifact data-key wrapping

200.description: X25519 public wrapping key only; no private key or data key is returned.

delete.summary: Delete one named envelope after verifying another recovery path

200.description: Envelope deleted; the custody key and other envelopes remain.

403.description: Envelope does not belong to the tenant, is unavailable, or lacks explicit recovery confirmation.

post.summary: Request the data key for one registered envelope

201.description: The named artifact data key for immediate in-memory use, plus a cache recommendation

403.description: Policy, envelope, subscription, or enrollment refusal

429.description: Temporary tenant recovery-release throttle; Retry-After and retry_after_seconds state when the UTC-hour window resets.

201.description: One-time replacement bearer token and Ed25519 private signing key; all prior enrolled-client credentials are revoked.

200.description: Credential identifiers, states, and creation times only; no tokens or private keys.

post.summary: Create one enrolled-client credential for one deployment

201.description: One-time credential id, bearer token, and Ed25519 private signing key.

200.description: Credential revoked; other enrolled clients remain unchanged.

201.description: One-time replacement management bearer token; all prior management credentials are revoked.

get.summary: Read bounded, tenant-scoped custody audit metadata

200.description: Recent operational events without keys, envelopes, tokens, or private signing material.

get.summary: Read plan, quota, renewal, custody availability, and the tenant's recent change requests
get.description: A passed renews_at pauses new key and envelope writes while preserving existing recovery unwraps.

patch.summary: Request a plan change or cancellation

get.description: Signed enrolled-client view only. It returns renewal/readiness evidence and no billing, management, key, or recovery material.

200.description: Envelope quota, current usage, current renewal state, and whether a new envelope may be stored.

delete.summary: Withdraw the tenant's pending subscription request

403.description: Request was not pending or does not belong to the tenant

post.summary: Create a hosted checkout or invoice session

patch.description: Internal control-plane endpoint. Its separate billing token can change subscription state only; it cannot manage or unwrap keys.

200.description: Entitlement applied and pending requests resolved

accountSession.description: Account management token; never valid for unwrap requests.

enrolledClient.description: Enrolled-client bearer credential plus required Ed25519 request-signature headers. mTLS can be added by the deployment proxy.

billingService.description: Private commercial billing-control token. It can apply entitlements only and is never accepted by custody key endpoints.

ClientSignature.name: X-HostScope-Signature
ClientSignature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature over METHOD, path, timestamp, nonce, and Base64 SHA-256 request-body hash separated by newlines.

confirm_recovery.description: Caller attests that another verified recovery path exists for this artifact.

label.description: Administrator label for one customer deployment; not an authentication value.

envelope_base64.description: Base64 X25519 sealed box containing exactly one 256-bit artifact data key; storage refuses envelopes it cannot open with the selected key.

unwrap_quota_per_hour.description: Temporary tenant-wide recovery-release throttle. It applies regardless of billing state and resets each UTC hour; it cannot permanently deny existing recovery.
